problem.objective_name: negative net horizontal chassis displacement divided by full trial duration

constraints.name: fall observed (chassis ground contact or overturning)

scope: Continuous 20-second travel. Optimize net distance/time without falling. No slip, lift, requested-speed tracking, heading, steering or stopping rejection. Physical CAD, actuator and runtime model preserved. Parameter ranges are initial search windows to expand, not physical ceilings. Fall geometry is sampled; timestep and longer-distance confirmation follow promising results. The 0.462 m/s candidate lies at the initial tracking-gain lower boundary. This experiment expands gain below zero and doubles the lead and requested-speed windows, preserving saturation and CAD physics. Negative gains and larger leads are experimental controller policies, not physical-property overrides or speed ceilings.
